items.name: Settler Intelligence Briefing
items.description:
Hostile rogue drones hunt and scavenge every system in this constellation we call Phoenix. They grow stronger as you move away from Angelice. They are reported more commonly near planets but sightings occur almost anywhere.

Large asteroid clusters have been cataloged in each system. In some, a large rogue drone structure appears to be devouring the raw ore and so the Settlers have begun calling the clusters 'Moon Eater'. Another location with dense resources has been found, but exploration attempts have failed due to an infested Abaddon who sits on watch. Ophidia Operations, based in Serpentis, are working on a technology to provide concealment.

Your starter pack contains a blueprint we believe will provide access to the system Askur, which is currently locked by sophisticated encryption. We don't know what Askur has in store.

Settler security forces have not yet been established, guard yourself. However, should your ship be destroyed, starter packs can be purchased from the market here in Angelice.

items.name: Crude Extractor
items.description: Module used in the extraction of crude matter required for all types of fuel by drawing exotic material through a crude rift.

items.name: Lens 60X
items.description: For use with Crude Extractors only.

items.name: Sophrogon
items.description: The light fraction refined from crude: rich in energy and quick to vaporise.

items.name: Crude - Old/Rough
items.description:
Braids of serenity and power entwine and disperse across the surface. Within, they dance as if begging to be set free. From this rhythm, the dreams of those long passed and those newly awoken may spring forth.

A quiet fragility eminates from the matter’s movements, the ethereal beauty of transience. Practicality has no need of such things.

items.name: Embark
items.description: Extra small hydrogen engine. Runs exclusively on hydrogen fuel.

items.name: Crustal Anorthosite Crystals
items.description:
Calcium-sodium aluminosilicate feldspar crystals from basaltic crust of differentiated asteroids.

Makes up most of Rind, Glaze and Marrow asteroids. Bone, Flint and Spall asteroids also carry it beneath their crust.

items.name: Nickel-Iron Veins
items.description:
Nickel-bearing alloys commonly intermixed with iron in metallic asteroids. 

Nickel-Iron Veins is commonly refined from Iron-Rich Nodules

items.name: Silicon Dust
items.description:
Abundant non-metal hosted in silicate minerals throughout asteroids. 

Silicon Dust is commonly refined from Silica Grains.

items.name: Tholin Aggregates
items.description:
Prebiotic tar-like organics produced by long-term radiation chemistry. 

Tholin Aggregates is commonly refined from Hydrocarbon Residue.

items.name: Platinum-Group Veins
items.description:
Rare platinum-group metals concentrated in differentiated asteroid cores. 

Platinum-Group Veins is commonly refined from Iron-Rich Nodules.

items.name: Massive Ataxite Matrix
items.description:
Platinum and palladium concentrated in nickel-rich metallic grains from intermediate core zones. Forms during slow cooling of differentiated asteroid cores.

Found deep in the metallic cores of Ingot and Spar asteroids. Flint and Spall asteroids hold smaller amounts beneath their crust.

items.name: Hydrated Gossan Matrix
items.description:
Water-bearing sulfide-rich material common in carbonaceous chondrites. Represents aqueous alteration of metal sulfides in the early solar system.

Rich deposits lie beneath the crust of Murk asteroids. Grist, Scale and Spar asteroids carry smaller amounts, and traces sit deep in the cores of Mire asteroids.

items.name: Unstable Fuel
items.description: Long abandoned and left to the mercy of the Static Shear, little energy or even structure remains. This lingering dross provides barely enough of a spark to power a vessel. Even the best refinery processes cannot prevent the decay of time from claiming their product.

items.name: Cutting Laser
items.description: A direct energy tool useful for breaking apart solid matter. Like many of its forebearers, it can serve needs beyond its intended purpose. Adaptation is necessary for survival.

items.name: Heavy Storage
items.description: A programmable storage unit.

items.name: Water Ice
items.description:
Essential volatile preserved in cold outer-belt environments.

Hydrated Gossan Matrix and Primitive Rime Shards are common sources of Water Ice.

items.name: Native Reef Nodules
items.description:
Dense iridium-osmium-ruthenium alloy nodules from the deepest, hottest core regions. Among the most refractory materials in the solar system.

Found in small amounts in the weathered surface of Ingot asteroids.

items.name: Crude - Young/Rough
items.description:
Currents of energy flicker almost playfully just beneath the surface. Deeper, the flows meld, forming a sea of emotion. The hue surrounding the matter changes with these internal tides, reflecting whichever passion dominates in the moment.

It is this mercurial nature which entices, which promises the ability to shape the future. So sweet is the call that danger, no matter how apparent, is easily ignored.

items.name: Eupraxite
items.description: The heavy fraction refined from crude: dense, rich in energy and slow to vaporise.

items.name: Primitive Rime Shards
items.description:
Pure methane ice preserved at cryogenic temperatures in outer asteroid belt regions.

Found frozen deep in the cores of Pitch asteroids, and beneath the crust of Mire and Char asteroids in smaller amounts.

items.name: Primordial Anthraxolite Sludge
items.description:
Unaltered complex organic polymer preserved from early solar system formation, less processed than C-type kerogen.

Common beneath the crust of Ember, Scale and Char asteroids, and present in most dark, carbon-rich bodies such as Mire and Pitch.

items.name: Irradiated Anthraxolite Veins
items.description:
Concentrated deposits of complex aromatic hydrocarbons formed through extended space weathering and radiation processing of organic ices.

Richest beneath the crust of Soot asteroids. Pitch asteroids also carry large veins, and Grist, Ember and Mire smaller ones.

items.name: Irradiated Cryoconite Nodules
items.description:
Prebiotic tar-like organics formed from radiation-driven chemistry.

Widespread beneath the crust of dark, carbon-rich asteroids, most of all Pitch, Char, Ember and Mire.

items.name: Purified Moon Cutting Laser
items.description: The violence necessary to obtain such a trophy has reduced its functionality to a fraction of its potential. Yet, this laser remains operational in the face of all the Frontier’s hostilities, natural and computational alike. Fitting a feralized component, even one with its protocols exorcised and rebuilt, can be considered an act of hubris.

items.name: Medium Cutting Laser
items.description: A direct energy tool useful for breaking apart solid matter. Like many of its forebearers, it can serve needs beyond its intended purpose. Flexibility has served the denizens of the Frontier well.

items.name: Fossilized Exotronics
items.description: The Null and Static Shears wreak havoc on most traditional forms of computation, rendering them nigh unusable in the Frontier. Exotronic technology's extreme adaptability and durability thus effectively make it the only option for automation in this environment. Faint remnants of activity in this debris suggest the potential for reclamation. Within these dull impulses of fragmented information, a hint of familiarity calls out.

As a result, the original intention behind this hull design has been lost to the millennia and data corruption has obscured even whether this design originates from a human or artificial mind. However, the data streams which led to this vessel's development have their origins in the K4T-Y region. (placeholder)

items.name: Feldspar Crystal Shards
items.description:
Fractured aluminum tectosilicate minerals common in rocky and differentiated asteroids, typically formed through magmatic cooling processes.

Feldspar Crystal Shards are commonly refined from Silica Grains.

items.name: D2 Fuel
items.description: Even the most mundane matter can be improved through synthesis with byproducts of Crude extraction. Plentiful and inefficient on the Frontier, hydrogen too may be uplifted through this process, breathing new life into reactors which would otherwise be left behind. A question remains: are these efforts efficient?

items.name: D1 Fuel
items.description: The allure of Crude Matter brought computation and humanity to the Frontier. As life reawakens, so too does the thirst for power in all its forms, including from the most mundane sources. Even in the face of the Static Shear, ice still litters the heavens. From its crystals, hydrogen may be extracted, reprocessed, and refined into fuel. This product, inefficient as it is, still drives the smallest vessels of the Frontier via its abundance and minimal cost.

items.name: Thermal Composites
items.description: An ablative silica-organic composite: its organic binder chars and carries heat away while a silicate filler holds the shape.

items.name: Still Knot
items.description: Computing salt from Rough crude with a captured machine-intelligence signal knotted in: a core that reads signals arriving over distances that should not be possible.

items.name: Mummified Corpse
items.description: An air of reverence lingers around this corpse. Marks of age and violence cannot fully conceal the care given to this body, long abandoned by its original owner. The time for remembrance, however, has passed.

items.name: Echo Chamber

items.name: Chitinous Organics
items.description:
Carbon-based polymer residues structurally analogous to chitin, indicative of complex prebiotic or biologically processed compounds.

Irradiated Anthraxolite Veins, Primitive Rime Shards, Primordial Anthraxolite Sludge and Irradiated Cryoconite Nodules are a common source of Chitinous Organics

items.name: Kerogen Tar

items.name: Defiled Crude Matter
items.description:
Human greed carves gashes into the surface. Past sins bind to the structures within, transforming the promised bounty into a twisted relic. It enters this universe broken and scarred, carrying only a fraction of its potential.

Yet it is still Crude. It can still rouse dreams thought long extinct. Perhaps even the accursed dream responsible for its creation.

items.name: Relay
items.description: Establishes a connection to EVE Net, allowing the purchase of data, thus enabling the fabrication Crude mining lenses, as well as the sale of feral data.

items.name: Hop
items.description:
A transit module for covering ground. Once engaged, the vessel holds its heading and is carried forward until the burn completes. An ancient choice for hopping between adjacent points of interest.

Among the oldest schemata found in the Frontier. It is simulated that countless variants have descended from a theorised original pattern, each adapted to different hulls and purposes, yet the core principle remains unchanged. The first makers understood something fundamental about motion that later work has only decorated.

items.name: Stride
items.description:
A frame stripped for range, built to leap between stars.
The design bears apparent alterations — conduits rerouted through spaces that seem improvised, geometries bent into configurations that defy intuition.
No signature remains to mark its maker.

items.name: Carom
items.description: A hull shaped for distance and solitude. The proportions are spare, stripped of anything not essential to the crossing. The drive assembly carries unexpected mass — bracing layered over bracing, housings reinforced beyond apparent need, structure filling spaces the original geometry left hollow. What necessity shaped these adaptations remains unclear.

items.name: Redundant Module
items.description: A fragment of endless growth, stripped of purpose yet stubbornly persistent.

items.name: Void Residue
items.description: A lingering trace of chaotic growth, the remnants of energy that once fueled a self-propagating anomaly.

items.name: Singularity Reactor Fragment
items.description: Small but potent, it pulses with the force that drives endless growth.

items.name: Void Fragments
items.description: Shards born from the collapse of unstable matter, whispering of relentless expansion and unseen forces.

items.name: Char
items.description:
Charred remnants of volcanic crust, these fire-scarred asteroids contain crystalline feldspar minerals forged in the intense heat of differentiated parent bodies. Their burnt, weathered surfaces hide valuable aluminum and silicon-rich crystals beneath layers of space-weathered rock.

Char asteroids are a common source of Feldspar Crystals  and can typically be found in Inner Belts.

items.name: Slag
items.description:
Industrial waste from the cosmos—metallic slag asteroids are the leftover cores of shattered worlds. Rich in platinum and palladium, these slowly-cooled metallic matrices represent the most precious remnants of planetary formation, concentrated in dense nickel-rich grains.

Slag asteroids are a common source of  Platinum-Palladium Matrix and can typically be found in Inner Belts.

items.name: Ingot
items.description:
Pure metallic ingots drifting through space, these asteroids are nature's own refined metal bars. Containing the densest materials known—iridium, osmium, and ruthenium—they're the treasure vaults of the asteroid belt, forged in the deepest, hottest cores of primordial worlds.

Ingot asteroids are a common source of Iridosmine Nodules.

items.name: Comet
items.description:
Primitive water-bearers from stellar formation, these comet-like asteroids hold preserved secrets in their hydrated sulfide cores. Part ice, part metal, they're time capsules of aqueous chemistry now frozen in the void.

Comet asteroids are a common source of Hydrated Sulfide Matrix and can typically be found in Outer Belts.

items.name: Dewdrop
items.description:
Delicate spheres of frozen volatiles, dewdrop asteroids glisten with crystalline methane ice preserved at near-absolute-zero temperatures. These fragile outer belt wanderers are reservoirs of pure cryogenic fuel, waiting to be harvested from the cold reaches of space.

Dewdrop asteroids are a common source of Methane Ice Shards.

items.name: Ember
items.description:
Still glowing with primordial organic heat, ember asteroids contain pristine kerogen—complex carbon polymers that have remained unaltered since formation. These dark, coal-like bodies hold valuable chemical building blocks.

Ember asteroids are a common source of Primitive Kerogen Matrix.

items.name: Glint
items.description:
Shimmering with rainbow-like iridescence, glint asteroids sparkle with veins of complex aromatic hydrocarbons. Radiation-forged through extended exposure, their surfaces gleam with polycyclic organic compounds—the cosmic equivalent of liquid crystal displays, beautiful and chemically exotic.

Glint asteroids are a common source of Aromatic Hydrocarbon Veins.

items.name: Soot
items.description:
Dark as coal dust and deeply primordial, soot asteroids are coated in prebiotic tholin nodules—tar-like organic compounds formed through radiation chemistry. These sooty spheres are laboratories of cosmic chemistry, their surfaces slowly processing in the radiation of deep space.

Soot asteroids are a common source of Tholin Nodules.

items.name: Crude - Young/Fine
items.description:
Tight weaves of energetic currents tangle and dissipate beneath the surface. Deeper, they merge so seamlessly as to appear singular in nature, concealing the true chaos seething within. The hue surrounding the matter subtly reflects this hidden truth, oscillating wildly between wave forms.

It is chaos which offers potential, enticing all who might stumble upon its power. So tempting is the possibility that risks may be easily ignored.

items.name: Turret
items.description: A medium base defence turret. Especially effective against mid sized ships.

items.name: Heavy Turret
items.description: A large base defence turret. Especially effective against larger ships.

items.name: Turret
items.description: A medium base defence turret. Especially effective against mid sized ships.

items.name: Heavy Turret
items.description: A large base defence turret. Especially effective against larger ships.

items.name: Crude - Old/Fine
items.description:
Dense braids of tranquil, potent energy dance across the surface. Within, they ply together as if seeking to become one. From this unmet desire, the fuel of dreams might be extracted, as practiced by those long passed.

The ethereal beauty of transience emanates from compacting, ever-shifting weaves of sinew. Appreciation goes beyond immediate need and can therefore be discarded.

items.name: Leap
items.description:
A transit module for covering ground. Once engaged, the vessel holds its heading and is carried forward until the burn completes. An ancient choice for hopping between adjacent points of interest.

Among the oldest schemata found in the Frontier. It is simulated that countless variants have descended from a theorised original pattern, each adapted to different hulls and purposes, yet the core principle remains unchanged. The first makers understood something fundamental about motion that later work has only decorated. ( copy ) ( copy )

items.name: Brine
items.description: The heavy brine drawn off with crude: a dense salt solution that dissolves and carries.

items.name: Still Kernel
items.description: Crystallised computing salt grown from crude. A porous ionic lattice whose ordered defects hold a state.

items.name: Field Cairn
items.description:
A Field Cairn is deployable anchor that fixes a signature to an exact point in space for those intending to return.

Cairns lack stabilizing thrusters and are inherently unstable, gradually degrading and drifting out of orbit within 24 hours.

items.name: Field Cairn
items.description:
A Field Cairn is deployable anchor that fixes a signature to an exact point in space for those intending to return.

Cairns lack stabilizing thrusters and are inherently unstable, gradually degrading and drifting out of orbit within 24 hours.

items.name: Thermal Shroud
items.description: Increases shell resistance to heat.

items.name: Knife
items.description: A direct energy tool useful for breaking apart solid matter. Like many of its forebearers, it can serve needs beyond its intended purpose. Adaptation is necessary for survival. ( copy )

items.name: Thrumming Strand
items.description: Driven by a sliver of the consciousness of its creator, it slithers around its container awaiting a purpose. Energy arcs from the thread of its body to any nearby objects, hinting at the possibilities and dangers locked within its form. In time, it may well become a creator, of sorts, in its own right.

items.name: Drained Strand
items.description: Its purpose fulfilled, only a wisp of its former shape remains. Gone are the slivers of consciousness, the thrumming energy. What lingers is still an agent of change, if not transcendence.

items.name: Emergency Printer
items.description: Provides onboard fabrication of small structural components and parts from raw material inputs.

items.name: Weapon Receiver
items.description: Internal structural housing that accepts external weapons through integrated hardpoint connections.

items.name: Cargo Container
items.description: Sealed storage bay for carrying cargo within the structure. Each fitted module increases the total cargo hold capacity.

items.name: Hull Repairer
items.description: Automated repair system that restores hull integrity over time while activated.

items.name: Cutting Laser
items.description: Multi purpose, Short-range cutting laser mounted on an external weapon hardpoint. Can be activated to mine, salvage or fend off minor threats.

items.name: Power Generator
items.description: Generates and distributes electrical power to the onboard powergrid, allowing for on-lining of modules.

items.name: Leap
items.description: High-energy propulsion unit enabling rapid short-range directional bursts of speed when activated.

items.name: Propulsion Engine R10
items.description: Primary drive unit providing sustained thrust. Provides multiple hardpoints slots for External Thrusters.

items.name: Ion Sensor
items.description: Monitors local signatures passively for resolving unknown entities with EM signatures.

items.name: Directional Scanner
items.description: External scanning array for active directional resolution of unknown ships, structures, and anomalies.

items.name: Command Pod
items.description: Central command unit housed in the root section of the structure, coordinating all onboard systems.

items.name: Fuel Bay
items.description: Pressurized storage tank for fuel reserves used by the Power Generator. Each fitted module increases the total fuel storage.

items.name: Capacitor
items.description: Energy buffer that stores and supplies charge to support activation of modules. Also serves as a  backup for the Power Generator should it temporarily go offline. Each fitted module increses the total power capacity.

items.name: External Thruster
items.description: Supplemental thrust unit attached to a Propulsion Engine hardpoint. Each fitted module increases the top velocity of the ship.

items.name: Homeostatic Inoculation
items.description: Removes any form of trauma from a shell.

items.name: Thermal Salve
items.description: Removes build up of conflagration. Immediately stops any active conflagration. Prevents new conflagration build up for some time.

items.name: Psyche Inoculation
items.description: Removes build up of feralization. Immediately stops any active feralization. Prevents new feralization build up for some time.

items.name: Emergency Processor
items.description: Provides onboard processing of ore, salvage, and parts into base materials.

items.name: Crude Extractor
items.description: Extracts valuable Crude Matter by drawing exotic material through a Crude Rift.

items.name: Mini Catapult
items.description: Establish your own logistics route with this short distance stargate.

items.name: Attitude Controller
items.description: Boosts external maneuvering thrusters at the cost of increased fuel consumption.

items.name: Heavy Catapult
items.description: Establish your own logistics route with this long distance stargate.

items.name: Ion Tube
items.description: Increases the strength of EM signatures.

items.name: Repeater
items.description: Allows activating auto-fire mode for weapons.

items.name: Gravity Chamber
items.description: Increases the strength of gravitational signatures.

items.name: Heavy Catapult
items.description: Establish your own logistics route with this long distance stargate.

items.name: Gravity Sensor
items.description: Monitors local signatures passively for resolving unknown entities with large gravity signatures. Provides a hardpoint slot for a Directional Scanner.

items.name: Stuttergun
items.description: A rapid-fire projectile gun. A tough barrel contains each shot, a heat frame sheds the firing heat, and a salvaged board times the bursts.

items.name: Transfuser
items.description: When activated on a locked target ship, transfers fuel from your ship's fuel bay into the target ship's fuel bay each cycle. Some fuel is lost in the transfer process.

items.name: Autohelm
items.description: While fitted and powered on, this computer allows automatic approach to objects in space.

items.name: Needle
items.description: Short-range combat laser mounted on an external weapon hardpoint. Can be activated to inefficiently mine or salvage but is more effective at fending off threats or initiating combat.

items.name: Thrust Overdrive
items.description: Interior propulsion assist module that burns fuel directly to add thrust above the Engine and Thruster baseline. Boost scales with fuel impulse and online Thruster count; full ship maneuverability is maintained while active.

items.name: Launch Bay
items.description: A storage module that ejects a payload into space. On activation, transfers heat from the ship into the charge and deploys it from the hull. Compatible with any Payload.

items.name: Heat Trap
items.description:
A payload deployed from a Launch Bay. On release it draws excess heat off your ship, then drifts and cools toward the surrounding temperature over its Cooling Period.

Destroying a Heat Trap vents its Stored Heat as a Thermal Discharge: radial thermal damage to every ship in range - allies and your own ship included. The hotter the trap when it dies, the stronger the discharge. While above its Volatility Threshold the trap is Volatile and cannot be scooped; once cooled below the threshold it turns inert and can be recovered.

Structurally fragile - any damage destroys it.

items.name: Rupture - Young/Fine/Low
items.description:
Currents of energy flicker almost playfully just beneath the surface. Deeper, the flows meld, forming a sea of emotion. 
The hue surrounding the matter changes with these internal tides, reflecting whichever passion dominates in the moment.
It is this mercurial nature which entices, which promises the ability to shape the future. So sweet is the call that danger, no matter how apparent, is easily ignored.

items.description:

items.name: Transponder
items.description: While broadcasting, announces an identification signal on a chosen channel - tribe or a set code - and marks other broadcasting ships in range as friend or foe. Broadcasting significantly increases the ship's EM emissions.

items.name: Fuel Blister
items.description: An auxiliary tank plumbed into the lowest point of the ship's fuel system. While online it extends the ship's fuel capacity; taken offline it seals shut, holding its share of the fuel until it is brought back online. Draws no power.

items.name: Phase Reagent
items.description: Removes build up of temporalization. Immediately stops any active temporalization. Prevents new temporalization build up for some time.

items.name: Transponder Beacon
items.description: A high-output identification beacon. When lit, the ship is held stationary and broadcasts a warpable rally point to every pilot in the solar system whose own transponder is actively operating with a matching code.

items.name: Blackstart Cell
items.description: An auxiliary capacitor bank faced with photothermal collectors. Gleans a slow trickle of charge from ambient starlight - nothing arrives in shadow, warp or the dark - and the trickle stops once the reserve's own share of the capacitor is full. Needs no fuel, power or CPU, so it keeps working on an otherwise dead ship. The stored charge is lost if the module is removed.

items.name: Field Sentry
items.description: A simple defensive system which can be deployed anywhere. Onboard power is finite and will only function for a limited time.

items.name: Psyche Veil
items.description: Increases shell resistance to feralization.

items.name: Phase Cerement
items.description: Increases shell resistance to temporalization.

items.name: Docking Clamp
items.description: While fitted and powered on, this electromagnetic clamp lets the ship anchor itself to a docking port. Activate it to reveal the ports around you, then interact with the port when in range.

items.name: Organics
items.description: Tarry carbon compounds, the kind found in dark meteorites. They burn readily.

items.name: Carbon
items.description: Pure carbon, anywhere from soot to graphite. It conducts, and it burns.

items.name: Carbon Dioxide
items.description: Frozen carbon dioxide, the same stuff as dry ice. It soaks up heat as it turns to gas.

items.name: Chromite-spinel
items.description: Black chromium-iron oxide that stands up to heat.

items.name: Copper
items.description: Soft red metal that carries current and heat.

items.name: Feldspar
items.description: Pale, glassy silicate, the commonest mineral in rocky crusts.

items.name: Platinoids
items.description: Platinum and its kin, metals that never tarnish. Very dense, and they speed up reactions without being used up.

items.name: Ilmenite
items.description: Black iron-titanium oxide, the mineral titanium is mined from. Dense for a stone, and it conducts a little when light hits it.

items.name: Iron sulfide
items.description: Iron and sulfur, the bronze-coloured mineral common in meteorites.

items.name: Light Volatiles
items.description: Frozen methane, with carbon monoxide and ammonia mixed in. Quick to turn to gas, quick to burn.

items.name: Nickel-iron
items.description: Iron-nickel metal, the stuff of iron meteorites.

items.name: Olivine
items.description: Magnesium-iron silicate, green when pure. Clear crystals of it are the gem peridot.

items.name: Schreibersite
items.description: Iron-nickel phosphide, a brassy mineral found almost only in meteorites. Magnetic, and it conducts.

items.name: Silica
items.description: Silicon dioxide, the stuff of quartz and glass.

items.name: Silicon carbide
items.description: Silicon and carbon bonded into one of the hardest materials known. It moves heat fast and holds its shape where most things melt.

items.name: Tetrataenite
items.description: Iron and nickel set into a neat, ordered crystal by ages of slow cooling.

items.name: Water
items.description: Plain ice, plus water locked inside wet minerals.

items.name: Regolith Collector
items.description:
Mining a composite body sheds regolith faster than any pilot can gather it by hand. This module sweeps a wide cone ahead of the ship, drawing loose regolith into the cargo hold a few fragments at a time for as long as it runs.

It has no grip on anything but loose regolith, and no patience for a full hold.

items.name: Propulsion Engine R25
items.description: Primary drive unit providing sustained thrust. Provides multiple hardpoints slots for External Thrusters.

items.name: Propulsion Engine R50
items.description: Primary drive unit providing sustained thrust. Provides multiple hardpoints slots for External Thrusters.

items.name: Printer
items.description: Provides onboard fabrication across the full component, module and munitions catalogue. Requires substantially more hull volume than an Emergency Printer.

items.name: Refinery
items.description: Provides onboard reprocessing across the full range of salvage, ore and exotic organics. Requires substantially more hull volume than an Emergency Processor.

items.name: Industry Printer
items.description:
A field fabricator that runs Industry schemas. Where a conventional printer stamps out identical copies, this one reads the properties of whatever you feed it and carries them into the product - the same schema with different feedstock gives a different module.

Fit it to your ship, then open the Keeper menu on the left and select Industry.

items.name: Racing Leap
items.description: High-energy propulsion unit enabling rapid short-range directional bursts of speed when activated. Tuned for racing, it keeps far more steering control while boosting.

items.name: Inkstone
items.description: Dark, carbon-bearing rock built mostly of Olivine.

items.name: Bitumen
items.description: Tarry rock, thick with Organics.

items.name: Greenstone
items.description: Green, water-worked rock, mostly Serpentine.

items.name: Adamant
items.description: Carbon-rich rock, mostly Silicon carbide.

items.name: Fieldstone
items.description: Ordinary stony rock, mostly Olivine and Pyroxene with flecks of metal.

items.name: Clinker
items.description: Slaggy mix of stone and metal, mainly Pyroxene and Nickel-iron.

items.name: Pyroxenite
items.description: Rock made mostly of Pyroxene, with a little metal.

items.name: Brimstone
items.description: Sulfide rock, mostly Iron sulfide.

items.name: Basalt
items.description: Volcanic rock, mostly Pyroxene and Feldspar.

items.name: Lampblack
items.description: Sooty rock, rich in Carbon.

items.name: Bloom
items.description: Raw iron-nickel metal, nearly all of it Nickel-iron.

items.name: Floe
items.description: Dirty ice, mostly Water, with rock and organic tar frozen through it.

items.name: Noble
items.description: Dense metal rock carrying the platinum metals.

items.name: Ochre
items.description: Rust-coloured rock, mostly Magnetite.

items.name: Peridotite
items.description: Green rock from deep inside a body that once melted, mostly Olivine.

items.name: Evaporite
items.description: Pale salt rock, left behind by water that dried away.

items.name: Hoarfrost
items.description: Loose frost of light ices, mostly Light Volatiles.

items.name: Pyroxene
items.description: Dark, blocky magnesium-iron silicate, common in volcanic rock and meteorites.

items.name: Magnetite
items.description: Black, magnetic iron oxide, the mineral lodestones are made of.

items.name: Serpentine
items.description: Soft green mineral that forms when water works on Olivine.

items.name: Salts
items.description: Rock salt and the other minerals brine leaves when it dries.

items.name: Armilla
items.description: A step towards making a great dream reality. The pursuit of perfection is an endless process of minor improvements, compounding into something beautiful. Even with melioration, any beauty here remains vulnerable in the pursuit of the sublime, however futile it might be.

items.name: Calliphor
items.description: Navigating the path towards perfection requires variation in strategy. At times, mere threats may be all that are needed to preserve a fragile state of beauty. Should the warnings go unheeded, the ensuing strike may well be enough to secure a moment of safety, no matter how fleeting.

items.name: Histerid
items.description: Capability begets hubris. What might seem invulnerable is rarely more than an illusion, though the despair induced is no less real. The appearance of perfection here is as fragile as the beauty found elsewhere.

items.name: Composite Hull Repairer
items.description: Automated repair system that restores hull integrity over time while activated.

items.name: Stack Slice 530
items.description: The remnants of ancient knowledge brought together once more. Computational life passes through this latticework of restored connections, forming new, twisted shapes of old data. There is no truth here, only stories half-remembered, sifted by the endless churn of time.

items.name: Fusion Head
items.description: A nozzle that burns propellant against a melt-proof liner, throwing a jet hot enough to fuse metal.

items.name: Heat Frame
items.description: A dense conductive block that soaks up heat fast and sheds it slowly, evening out sharp thermal spikes.

items.name: Arc Shroud
items.description: Magnet and conductor coils wound into a cage that holds an electric arc in place and keeps it off its surroundings.

items.name: Chamber R10
items.description: A thick refractory pressure chamber that keeps its strength as the burn inside heats it.

items.name: Chamber R25
items.description: A larger refractory pressure chamber, walled to hold its strength at higher burn temperatures.

items.name: Chamber R50
items.description: The heaviest refractory pressure chamber, walled to hold its strength at the highest burn temperatures.

items.name: Ion Detector (Sensor)
